description: A photograph shows an expanse of Dry Mediterranean grasslands in the Extremadura region, South Western Spain. The foreground is dominated by varied green and dry grasses, with taller, drier vegetation prominent on the right. In the middle ground, several scattered trees and shrubs are visible, along with distant structures of what appears to be a small settlement. Rolling, vegetated hills extend into the background beneath a partly cloudy sky. The image is attributed to "M. Palacios" and includes a copyright notice in the lower-left corner: "© Copernicus | EEA, 2018". This image is an example of land cover classified as grassland, specifically natural grasslands or dry Mediterranean grasslands.
